classification.rule: D1-D6 model-free classifier: reject idle/recovery readings below 10 degC, any valid reading above 125 degC, one-second jumps > half the step rise, and stale idle series; D1(d) uses the largest rise among D4-qualified, unclamped keys within 1 s of the shortest stable cooling time (load-tail rise/e, from actual load end), and excludes rise > that reference rise +1.0 degC; clamps excluded from picks. Baseline is the last-60 s idle median; noise is OLS residual SD. Both roles need rise >=3 degC, rise and positive rise60 >3 noise floors, and tau*ln(rise/1 degC) <=300 s. Fast (legacy die): cooling tau <=60 s, noise <=1/3 degC, largest rise. Slow (legacy heatsink): 60 < tau <=300 s, noise <=0.15 degC, longest band hold. Lexical ties. Each phase needs >=99% one-second-cell coverage, <1% read errors, and no two consecutive empty cells. Unsettled baselines are flagged, not refused; R0 picks remain PROVISIONAL.
